trust_decision.summary: recoverAccount decides that two distinct recovery codes match two distinct stored bcrypt hashes before issuing a password-reset token; dedupe ran before trim and matches did not consume hashes, so one code with whitespace variants counted twice.

landing_point.why: Only place recovery codes are deduplicated and normalised; summary names whitespace normalisation of recovery codes.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No O2 site or O8 route exists; the only arguable dismissal is the hash-consumption half of the fix ('uuid validate + bcrypt make two distinct strings matching one hash impossible after trim-then-dedupe'), see fix.diff:28-40.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A legitimate user pasting two distinct codes with surrounding whitespace/newlines (or sending extra codes beyond two, only first two unique taken) must still recover; an over-broad fix rejecting untrimmed input or >2 codes would break this.

O6_input_shapes: leading/trailing whitespace variants of the same code (trim before dedupe)
non-string array elements (typeof guard; crashed with 500 at pinned commit)
same code matching one hash twice (hash consumed on match)

O7_producer.where: server/models/passwordRecovery.js:64-69 (hashesForUser, plain DB read, no normalisation)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second recovery route (e.g. an API-key/developer-API or single-user-mode recover endpoint) with its own copy of the dedupe-then-trim loop
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: server/endpoints/api/ mirrors many system endpoints; a maintainer could copy recoverAccount logic inline rather than import it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: hashesForUser returning hashes from multiple generation rounds or duplicated rows, so per-hash consumption is defeated at the data layer
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: generateRecoveryCodes (server/utils/PasswordRecovery/index.js:9-31) inserts without deleting prior codes; a producer-level sibling there would be how-type.

O9_family: input canonicalisation before uniqueness check (CWE-180) leading to auth factor reuse (CWE-287)

O10_build.toolchain: yarn/npm, jest ^29.7.0 at repo root (package.json:21,47), Prisma with SQLite
O10_build.project_tests: none for PasswordRecovery under server/__tests__ (grep found no matches); recoverAccount needs Prisma User/RecoveryCode mocks or a SQLite DB

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Move .map(trim) before new Set(...) and stop, without consuming matched hashes or guarding non-string elements.

out_of_scope_notes: generateRecoveryCodes (server/utils/PasswordRecovery/index.js:9-31) does not delete earlier codes before inserting new ones; not pursued.
Recovery endpoint has no visible rate limiting at server/endpoints/system.js:385-388; not pursued.
